open_findings.title: Retain verifiable object/configuration/refresh facts

spec.quote: 公开收据绑定 exact source/lock/image/tools、每个object及观测PUT/GET、全部config before/after、URL完整集合/拒绝原因、部分副作用和cleanup。

open_findings.observed: The 354 rows in the successful public SDK receipt contain only method/action/object_key. GET readback facts, configuration before/after, and exact refresh URL/task coverage are not retained. They exist in local execution assertions; counts are not equivalent reviewable evidence. The work bundle is removed and not uploaded by CI.
open_findings.minimal_remedy: Persist bounded sanitized per-generation object manifest and actual PUT/full-GET facts, complete configuration before/after/readback and exact refresh URLs/task rows; omit headers/tokens/raw signed URLs. Preserve partial facts on failure.

open_findings.title: Fail the SDK stage on an unexpected blocked socket attempt

spec.quote: socket尝试、cleanup失败、日志超限 | driver非零、always有限收据

open_findings.observed: The network guard raises RuntimeError, which refused() accepts. The helper probe intercepted one unexpected connect and refused() returned normally; zero actual connects occurred. Provider exception wrapping can also convert the guard error to ProviderError/ValueError, so narrowing refused() alone is insufficient.
open_findings.minimal_remedy: Keep a bounded guard-attempt counter outside exception classification. Separate the intentional guard self-check, then require zero unexpected attempts for the entire SDK stage, with incomplete receipt and nonzero outcome on violation.

open_findings.title: Write an incomplete receipt even if scratch cleanup fails

spec.quote: cleanup失败、日志超限 | driver非零、always有限收据

open_findings.observed: shutil.rmtree() in finally can raise before output.write_bytes(). The probe injected a prior stage ValueError then a cleanup PermissionError: main raised PermissionError and no receipt existed. This loses the original failure and any side-effect observations.
open_findings.minimal_remedy: Capture cleanup failure separately, mark incomplete/scratch_removed=false, preserve the original stage error and attempts, and still serialize the bounded receipt before returning nonzero.
